content.content: Implement and verify a left rotation that enforces the "Left-Leaning" invariant for a Left-Leaning Red-Black Tree (LLRBT). In LLRBTs, Red links are only allowed on the left. If a Red link appears on the right (Black Parent $\to$ Red Right Child), this operation rotates the edge to make it a Left Red link. **Verification Specification** Preconditions: The node has a right child that is Red.The node itself is usually Black. Postconditions: (1) Structure: The original right child becomes the new root; the original parent becomes the new left child. (2) Set Preservation: The view() must be identical. (3) Color Logic: The new root must take the same color as the old root (preserving the black height for the tree above). The new left child (old root) must become Red. (4) Balance Preservation: Prove res.black_height() == node.black_height(). ---- 1 use vstd::prelude::*; 2 3 verus! { 4 // Following is the block for necessary definitions 5 // 6 pub struct Node { 7 pub val: u64, 8 pub is_red: bool, 9 pub left: Option>, 10 pub right: Option>, 11 } 12 13 impl Node { 14 // Standard Set View 15 pub open spec fn view(&self) -> Set 16 decreases self 17 { 18 let left_set = match &self.left { Some(l) => l.view(), None => Set::empty() }; 19 let right_set = match &self.right { Some(r) => r.view(), None => Set::empty() }; 20 left_set.union(right_set).insert(self.val) 21 } 22 23 // Standard BST Order 24 pub open spec fn is_bst(&self) -> bool 25 decreases self 26 { 27 (match &self.left { 28 Some(l) => (forall |x| #[trigger] l.view().contains(x) ==> x < self.val) && l.is_bst(), 29 None => true, 30 }) && (match &self.right { 31 Some(r) => (forall |x| #[trigger] r.view().contains(x) ==> x > self.val) && r.is_bst(), 32 None => true, 33 }) 34 } 35 36 // --- LLRBT SPECIFICS --- 37 38 // Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid 39 pub open spec fn black_height(&self) -> int 40 decreases self 41 { 42 let lh = match &self.left { Some(l) => l.black_height(), None => 1 }; 43 let rh = match &self.right { Some(r) => r.black_height(), None => 1 }; 44 45 if lh != -1 && rh != -1 && lh == rh { 46 if !self.is_red { lh + 1 } else { lh } 47 } else { 48 -1 49 } 50 } 51 52 // Local Red-Black Rules 53 pub open spec fn satisfies_red_props(&self) -> bool 54 decreases self 55 { 56 let left_ok = match &self.left { Some(l) => l.satisfies_red_props(), None => true }; 57 let right_ok = match &self.right { Some(r) => r.satisfies_red_props(), None => true }; 58 59 // Rule: No Right-Leaning Red 60 let right_is_black = match &self.right { Some(r) => !r.is_red, None => true }; 61 62 // Rule: No Double Red on Left 63 let no_double_red = match &self.left { 64 Some(l) => if l.is_red { match &l.left { Some(ll) => !ll.is_red, None => true } } else { true }, 65 None => true, 66 }; 67 68 left_ok && right_ok && right_is_black && no_double_red 69 } 70 71 // Main Invariant 72 // Note: This allows the root to be Red or Black, 73 // which enables us to use it in the recursive insert spec. 74 pub open spec fn is_llrbt(&self) -> bool { 75 self.is_bst() && 76 self.black_height() != -1 && 77 self.satisfies_red_props() 78 } 79 } 80 // 81 82 // Following is the block for potential helper specifications 83 // 84 85 // 86 87 // Following is the block for proofs of lemmas, or functions that help the implementation or verification of the main specification 88 // 89 90 // 91 92 // Following is the block for the main specification 93 // 94 // Operation: Rotate Left (Fixup) 95 // Distinct from BST rotate because it MUST prove black_height is preserved. 96 fn fixup_rotate_left(node: Box) -> (res: Box) 97 requires 98 node.is_bst(), 99 node.right.is_some() && node.right.get_Some_0().is_red, 100 ensures 101 // Structural 102 res.is_bst(), 103 res.view() =~= node.view(), 104 105 // 1. Structural Guarantee 106 // In a left rotation, the old 'node' becomes the new left child. 107 res.left.is_some(), 108 109 // Colors & Balance 110 res.black_height() == node.black_height(), 111 res.is_red == node.is_red, 112 113 // 2. Safe Access 114 res.left.get_Some_0().is_red, 115 // 116 // 117 { 118 // Implement and verify the left rotation operation 119 } 120 // 121 122 fn main() {} 123 }description.md llrbt_rotateleft.rs
